sections.title: Items
sections.note: Upgrades of one item are its tiers: Sword, Shield and Power Bracelet.

items.name: Sword
items.notes: The Level 2 Sword is the Koholint Sword on Switch, given at 40 of the remake's 50 seashells.

tiers.name: Sword
tiers.howTo: Wash up with it on Toronbo Shores, east along the beach from Mabe Village.

tiers.name: Level 2 Sword
tiers.howTo: Bring 20 Secret Seashells to the Seashell Mansion in Ukuku Prairie.
tiers.reward: Twice the damage, and beams at full health

items.name: Shield
items.notes: A Like Like can eat the Shield: buy another for 20 Rupees at the Town Tool Shop.

tiers.name: Shield
tiers.howTo: Tarin gives it back when you wake in his house.

tiers.name: Mirror Shield
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of Eagle's Tower (Level 7).

items.name: Magic Powder
items.howTo: Take the Sleepy Toadstool from the west of the Mysterious Forest to Syrup at the Witch's Hut.
items.notes: She makes more each time you bring a Toadstool. Also a Trendy Game prize.

items.name: Roc's Feather
items.howTo: The dungeon item of Tail Cave (Level 1).

items.name: Shovel
items.howTo: Buy it at the Town Tool Shop for 200 Rupees.
items.notes: Needed for the Slime Key, and for many seashells.

items.name: Bombs
items.howTo: Buy them at the Town Tool Shop, 10 for 10 Rupees, or find them in pots and from enemies.
items.notes: On Switch the shop sells them only after Bottle Grotto (Zelda's Palace).

items.name: Power Bracelet
items.notes: L-2 is the Powerful Bracelet on Switch.

tiers.name: Power Bracelet
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of Bottle Grotto (Level 2).

tiers.name: Power Bracelet L-2
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of Face Shrine (Level 6). Lifts the heaviest rocks and the Weathercock.

items.name: Pegasus Boots
items.howTo: The dungeon item of Key Cavern (Level 3).

items.name: Ocarina
items.howTo: In the Dream Shrine in Mabe Village: sleep in the bed and cross the dream room with the Power Bracelet and Pegasus Boots.

items.name: Flippers
items.howTo: The dungeon item of Angler's Tunnel (Level 4).

items.name: Hookshot
items.howTo: The dungeon item of Catfish's Maw (Level 5), won from Master Stalfos at the end of four fights.

items.name: Bow
items.howTo: Buy it at the Town Tool Shop for 980 Rupees. It's on sale once you've bought the Shovel.
items.notes: It can be stolen, at the price of being called THIEF from then on (and on DX, a photo).

items.name: Magic Rod
items.howTo: The dungeon item of Turtle Rock (Level 8).

items.name: Boomerang
items.howTo: With the Magnifying Lens, bomb the cave on the east of Toronbo Shores. The Goriya inside swaps it for the item on your B button (the Shovel is the usual choice).
items.notes: Not every item can be swapped. On Game Boy and DX you can swap back; on Switch you buy your item back for 300 Rupees. The Magnifying Lens ends the Trading Sequence.

items.name: Secret Medicine
items.howTo: Buy it from Crazy Tracy at her Health Spa.
items.notes: Refills your hearts when you fall. Only one can be carried. DX and Switch also hide it in chests in the last dungeons.

sections.title: Capacity Upgrades
sections.note: The three Mad Batters (Li'l Devils on Switch): one upgrade each, your choice.

items.name: Magic Powder capacity
items.howTo: Choose it from a Mad Batter: sprinkle Magic Powder on one of his three altars.
items.notes: The three Mad Batters are under a rock near the middle of the Mysterious Forest (Power Bracelet), down stairs ringed by bushes in the south-west of Martha's Bay, and under a rock on the west of the Tal Tal Mountain Range on the way to Turtle Rock (Hookshot). Each gives one upgrade, and you choose: his first offer is Magic Powder, and saying you're not ready moves on to Bombs, then Arrows. On Game Boy and DX he offers only what you already carry.

items.name: Bomb capacity
items.howTo: Choose it from a Mad Batter.
items.notes: On Switch you start with 20. The three Mad Batters are under a rock near the middle of the Mysterious Forest (Power Bracelet), down stairs ringed by bushes in the south-west of Martha's Bay, and under a rock on the west of the Tal Tal Mountain Range on the way to Turtle Rock (Hookshot). Each gives one upgrade, and you choose: his first offer is Magic Powder, and saying you're not ready moves on to Bombs, then Arrows. On Game Boy and DX he offers only what you already carry.

items.name: Arrow capacity
items.howTo: Choose it from a Mad Batter.
items.notes: On Switch you start with 20. The three Mad Batters are under a rock near the middle of the Mysterious Forest (Power Bracelet), down stairs ringed by bushes in the south-west of Martha's Bay, and under a rock on the west of the Tal Tal Mountain Range on the way to Turtle Rock (Hookshot). Each gives one upgrade, and you choose: his first offer is Magic Powder, and saying you're not ready moves on to Bombs, then Arrows. On Game Boy and DX he offers only what you already carry.

sections.title: Golden Leaves
sections.note: All five are at Kanalet Castle; Richard trades them for the way to the Slime Key.

items.name: The Crow
items.howTo: Throw a rock at the Crow on the castle's west side and beat it.
items.after: Kiki's bridge to Kanalet Castle (trade the Bananas)
items.notes: Give all five to Richard at Richard's Villa to open the way to Pothole Field and the Slime Key.

items.name: The Mad Bomber
items.howTo: Hit the Mad Bomber who pops out of the holes on the castle's east side.
items.after: Kiki's bridge to Kanalet Castle (trade the Bananas)
items.notes: Give all five to Richard at Richard's Villa to open the way to Pothole Field and the Slime Key.

items.name: The Zol and Darknuts
items.howTo: Beat the enemies in the room with a Zol and two Darknuts.
items.after: Kiki's bridge to Kanalet Castle (trade the Bananas)
items.notes: Give all five to Richard at Richard's Villa to open the way to Pothole Field and the Slime Key.

items.name: Behind the marked wall
items.howTo: Bomb the wall marked with a symbol and beat the Darknut behind it.
items.after: Kiki's bridge to Kanalet Castle (trade the Bananas)
items.notes: Give all five to Richard at Richard's Villa to open the way to Pothole Field and the Slime Key.

items.name: The Ball and Chain Trooper
items.howTo: Beat the Ball and Chain Trooper.
items.after: Kiki's bridge to Kanalet Castle (trade the Bananas)
items.notes: Give all five to Richard at Richard's Villa to open the way to Pothole Field and the Slime Key.

sections.title: Switch Fairy Bottles
sections.note: The Switch remake adds three bottles for fairies; the Game Boy and DX versions have none. Counted apart.

items.name: The Ghost's thanks
items.howTo: Take the Ghost to the House by the Bay and then to his grave; he leaves a bottle.

items.name: Bottom of the Fishing Pond
items.howTo: Hook it from the bottom of the pond in Mabe Village.

items.name: Dampé: Heart Shortage
items.howTo: Clear Dampé's "Heart Shortage" Chamber Dungeon challenge.
